name: mac8_gpt2_124m
description: 8-bit pipelined multiply-accumulate unit derived from gpt2_124m: datapath from the model quantization, accumulator sized for its longest reduction

derivation.signedness_rule: symmetric quantization is two's complement signed, so operands, product and accumulator are all signed
derivation.pipeline_rule: 2 stages up to an 8-bit datapath, 3 above it: the signed multiply is the critical path and splitting it into half-width partial products buys the clock back for one cycle of latency

behavior: Stage 1 registers the full 16-bit product a*b and the valid flag.
The final stage adds the registered product into the 28-bit accumulator when the piped valid is set.
clear synchronously zeroes acc and valid_out, taking priority over accumulation.
Latency from valid_in to valid_out is 2 cycles.
28 accumulator bits = 16 product bits + 12 guard bits, enough for a 3072-deep dot product with no overflow.
Operands, product and accumulator are signed two's complement. The multiply must be a signed multiply and the product must be sign-extended into the accumulator.
